title.rendered: Student with Teacher placement date change – 9/2/21

content.rendered: Teacher emails to families regarding student placement has been changed to Thursday, Sept. 2nd. All emails will be sent by 3:30 pm. Please watch for your email introducing your child’s 2021-22 classroom teacher.
